works.body:
Hello! Can you draw my character?

Clementine “Clem”
- Messy copper hair, kind hazel eyes. Androgynous appearance. 
- Young bar owner in 1917, Arizona. His saloon is called the Lucky Lantern. His typical clients are miners. 
- Clem is optimistic, almost bordering on foolish and gullible, but this all comes from a genuine love for people. 
- He has a stubborn streak and sees failure only as a minor setback. He believes that with enough heart and hard work, a bad situation can be turned around. 

Motifs: liquor, flame, bandaged hands, black bandanas, canaries, soot, lanterns

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1_0gcYZwy7fvzlmdTydbvPp90ffXeXP9j

Mr. Comerow.

Thank you very much for your last order!
We were very impressed with your beautiful illustrations!
I would like to send my request to you again.

Details of the request
As with the previous request, we would like to request a single picture that could be made into a calendar (it will be used as an image for non-commercial use).
(We plan to use it as an image for non-commercial use.
The same head height as the previous request.
Front view, back view, no specification.
We would like to have an image like a stylish fashion snapshot.
We would like to leave the clothing to the client.
We would like to have a sense of the season (end of the year atmosphere).
・It doesn't matter whether the mask is worn or not, but we would like the elements to be included somewhere.
If you write the face under the mask, please use blue for the eyes.

Usage
Use in YouTube thumbnails or in distribution/videos
Use in various SNS such as Twitter tweets, etc.
Use in other VTuber activities in general

■Data contents
We would be very happy to receive PSD files, but we will leave it up to Comerow.
If you have text, background, etc., it would be very helpful if you could separate them.

If there are no problems with your request, we would appreciate it if you could accept it.
If the amount of money is not enough, or if you do not accept the requested illustration in the first place, please cancel the request!
Thank you very much in advance!

Mr. Comerow.

It is nice to meet you!
I saw your illustration on X and was attracted by your beautiful touch!
So, I would like to ask you to draw my character! I would like to ask you to draw my character!

Request details
I would like to commission you to draw a single picture that could be made into a calendar (it will be used as an image for non-commercial use).
I felt that the taste of your illustration would make a stylish image, so I made this request!
Our requests are as follows
The image should have the same head and body style as the one you have shown on your social networking site.
Front view, back view, no specification.
We would like the image to be like a stylish fashion snapshot.
We would like to leave the clothes to you.
We would like to have some element of blue, black, white, or gray in the shades.
We would like it to have a seasonal feel (fall/winter).
I would like the masks to be worn either way, but I would like the elements to be included somewhere.
If you write the face under the mask, please use blue for the eyes.

Usage
Use in YouTube thumbnails and videos
Use in various SNS such as Twitter tweets, etc.
Use in other VTuber activities in general

■Data Contents
We would be very happy to receive PSD files, but we will leave it up to Comerow.
If you have text, background, etc., it would be very helpful if you could separate them.

If there are no problems with your request, we would appreciate it if you could accept it.
If the amount of money is not enough, or if you do not accept the requested illustration in the first place, please cancel the request!
Thank you very much in advance!
